```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
```

### load data
```{r}
dat <- fread("./permutation_score_stability")
```
### Exploratory Data Analysis
```{r}
par()
ggplot(data=dat) + 
  geom_line(aes(x = perm_run, y = WNT ),color = "blue")+
  labs(x = "permutation runs", y = "Empricial P values", title = "Empricial P values Vs. Permutation Times for WNT Pathway" )

ggplot(data=dat) + 
  geom_line(aes(x = perm_run, y = BCR ), alpha = 0.2, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue")
```
